task_restatement.description: The only plain-text field: the original task in your own words, including acceptance criteria. A few sentences. Write file paths with forward slashes (src/app/main.ts), never backslashes.

done_so_far.description: A LIST of short strings, one step per item — not a paragraph. Example: ["Fixed the SELECT in src/repositories/order-repository.ts", "Added a regression test in test/unit/order-service.test.ts"].

remaining.description: A LIST of short strings, one remaining step per item.

decisions.description: A LIST of short strings, one decision (and why) per item. A new session must not revisit them.

constraints.description: A LIST of short strings, one constraint per item.

open_problems.description: A LIST of short strings, one problem per item. Empty list if none.

key_files.description: A LIST of paths a new session should read first, with forward slashes (src/app/main.ts), never backslashes. A handful, not every file touched.
